item.title: Magic’s Franz Wagner Has High Ankle Sprain

item.title: Terry Rozier Pleads Not Guilty To Federal Gambling Charges
item.description: Heat guard Terry Rozier pleaded not guilty to two federal charges related to illegal sports betting on Monday in Brooklyn federal court, reports Mike Vorkunov of The Athletic. item.title: Jaylen Brown, Jamal Murray Named Players Of The Week
item.description: Celtics wing Jaylen Brown and Nuggets guard Jamal Murray have been named the NBA’s Players of the Week, the league announced on Monday (via Twitter). item.title: Hawks’ Jacob Toppin Undergoes Season-Ending Shoulder Surgery
item.description: Third-year forward Jacob Toppin, who is on a two-way contract with the Hawks, will miss the remainder of the 2025/26 season after undergoing surgery on Monday to repair a torn labrum in his right shoulder, the team announced in a press release.
